item.title: Benchmarking LLM Inference on RTX 5070 Ti: AWQ vs NVFP4 and Why Prefix Caching Changes Everything
item.description: I benchmarked two quantization formats and prefix caching on NVIDIA’s Blackwell consumer GPU. AWQ beat NVFP4 by 56% in throughput, and prefix caching reduced time-to-first-token by 96.5% on a 7.5k token RAG context.
